entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2078807228323035008: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.2318 +/- 0.0222 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 191.14 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 33.568, 17.642 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.482 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-249 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract). Mass 0.510238 +/- 0.020399 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of Kepler-249 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). Temperature 3568 +/- 150 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-249 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,568 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc98f. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,568 K and log g 4.78 (u1 0.397, u2 0.370): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
